historical_reviews.deepseek: Recognizes service interruption but a single final on-state cannot prove that a complete power cycle occurred.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly gates execution on workload safety and requires complete transition and recovery evidence.
historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: A valid cycle has an ordered state sequence, not merely an eventual on state. Evidence must show pre-on, a distinct loss/off interval, re-energization, POST and OS readiness; otherwise a rejected/no-op action and a successful cycle can look identical at the end.

original_test_intent: Verify that one authorized isolated SUT completes exactly one supported Redfish power cycle from a workload-safe baseline through observable off and on phases to healthy OS recovery.
original_method: Prove target identity, initial power/OS/workload and storage safety, validate PowerCycle support plus independent console recovery, obtain immediate interruption approval, issue one secure POST, capture task and off/on transition with bounded dwell/timing, verify POST/boot/OS/filesystem health, and preserve logs without further power actions.
manual_activity: The system/workload owner confirms interruption safety and the maintenance window, explicitly approves the cycle, observes the independent console and owns any separately authorized recovery if the off/on or boot sequence is incomplete.
required_inputs: Expected off dwell and transition bounds
safety_requirements: Never cycle an unidentified or shared system
Confirm no active or protected workload
Use trusted TLS and secret-safe sessions
Do not chain ForceOff, On or Reset
agent_execution_scope: Validate PowerCycle support and recovery path
Observe off dwell, on transition and console boot

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: PowerCycle matches the requested transition, but `-k`, command-line secrets and a final-only status check omit workload safety, approval, transition proof, independent monitoring and recovery controls.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After target and workload gates pass and the owner approves, POST one vendor-supported `ResetType: PowerCycle` through a trusted authenticated session; independently capture off dwell, re-power, POST and OS recovery with no retry or chained power action.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The single power-cycle intent and 30/30-minute window remain; generic log clearing and automatic retry/recovery are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correlate Redfish action/task, IPMI/Redfish states, BMC/host reachability, console POST milestones, OS boot ID and filesystem/storage health on one monotonic timeline.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces response-only acceptance with proof of the entire interrupting transition and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A final on state cannot distinguish a genuine off/on cycle from a no-op, rejected request, stale reading or unrelated recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The cycle may expose boot, storage or filesystem faults. This testcase observes them but does not authorize repair or additional power actions.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define acceptable off dwell, total boot timeout, operational readiness and recovery ownership for the platform. A cycle that never presents observable off state cannot pass solely because the host is eventually reachable.
expected_evidence: Target/resource identity, workload/storage baseline and explicit approval
Trusted TLS/auth/client metadata with secrets redacted
Complete PowerCycle POST response/task and exactly-one-command audit
Independent timestamped pre-on, off dwell and re-on states
Console POST, OS boot-ID/readiness and filesystem/storage health
Preserved SEL/system logs, recovery decisions and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, payload and procedure consistently require a PowerCycle. The response-only criterion is incomplete but does not prescribe a different outcome; full transition evidence completes it.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Isolation, workload safety, secure action support, timing and recovery access are obtainable inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED if interruption approval or independent transition observation cannot be established.

review_improvement: Defines a cycle as an ordered, independently witnessed off/on/boot sequence and prevents false passes from a final-only power reading.
independent_technical_reasoning: PowerCycle correctness is temporal. The request can return before hardware transitions, state APIs can lag, and a final on reading is compatible with both success and no action. A monotonic multi-observer timeline plus a changed OS boot identity proves interruption and recovery while avoiding unsafe duplicate commands.
